entries.result: One exact pre-Resolve record selected vtable 0x82047628 and its +0x0C provider 0x82517800.
The provider exports wrapper +0x14 as its first output, zeroes its second output, and returns one.
The static factory, publication, reference-count, cleanup, and dynamic lower-release paths are bounded without assigning the runtime-selected wrapper to this factory.

The alternate factory pre-call supplies r4/r5 from source/context virtual +0x48/+0x4C results, r6 literal 1, r7 from configuration +0x0C after its bounded conditional patch, and r8 literal 0; no public dimension or format/usage name is assigned.

conclusion: One exact pre-Resolve runtime record selected vtable 0x82047628 and provider 0x82517800. That provider returns selected-wrapper field +0x14 as the first output that reaches Resolve r6, writes zero as its second output, and returns true. Static factory 0x82517EC0 creates a distinct 24-byte wrapper, obtains +0x14 through a dynamic device +0x08 creator, optionally copies 68 bytes of separate metadata, and publishes the wrapper through a refcounted link; one caller also publishes the resource at outer +0x58. Cleanup decrements resource and wrapper reference counts, clears wrapper fields, and selects a lower release slot through dynamic classification. No runtime edge joins the observed wrapper to that factory or identifies the creator leaf. The resource header builder, lower allocation and backing identity, mutation or contents generation, concrete lower release, and address recycling remain unresolved.
